events.title: Costume Carnival
events.venue: Gateway Pavilion at St. Elizabeths East
events.address: Gateway Pavilion, St. Elizabeths East, Washington, DC
events.description: Events DC hosts a family costume celebration with trick-or-treating, music and a costume contest. Register through the organizer before heading to the pavilion.

events.title: Hill-O-Ween at Eastern Market
events.address: Eastern Market, Capitol Hill, Washington, DC
events.description: Bring the family to Capitol Hill’s Halloween gathering. The organizer confirms the Friday date and Eastern Market setting; check its updates for the final activity lineup.

events.title: Measure for Measure
events.address: 201 East Capitol Street SE, Washington, DC 20003
events.description: Shakespeare’s dark comedy is reimagined in the 1950s American South. The final weekend offers different matinee and evening choices; reserve the specific performance.

events.title: Soul Strolls: Becoming America
events.description: Costumed interpreters bring American lives into focus on a lantern-lit cemetery tour. Your booked time is queue check-in, not an exact departure.

events.title: American Icon: The US Flag in Art
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, East Building
events.address: 4th Street and Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: Explore how artists have reimagined the American flag, from patriotic symbols to protest. This focused exhibition spans works from the 1800s onward.

events.title: BOOtanical Halloween Scavenger Hunt
events.priceLabel: $10 scavenger sheet; check source for garden admission
events.description: Follow a story trail into the Children’s Garden and search for seasonal surprises. A completed scavenger sheet earns a prize.

events.title: Butler’s Orchard Pumpkin Festival
events.description: Make a family farm outing of the autumn harvest. Reserve ahead: weekend admission can sell out, and outdoor activities depend on weather.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival
events.description: Hayrides, giant slides and farm attractions make a full autumn outing. Tickets are online only; reserve before driving because popular dates sell out.

events.title: Fields of Fear
events.description: Brave the haunted hayride, Cornightmare and forest attractions after dark. Attraction entry slots are assigned when you check in, not when you buy.

events.title: Fifth District Trunk or Treat
events.description: A local Halloween alternative hosted by MPD’s Fifth District. The official Safe Haven schedule confirms the station location and two-hour Friday evening window.

events.title: Fourth District Haunted House and Trunk or Treat
events.description: Choose a neighborhood Halloween stop with a haunted house and trunk-or-treat activities. MPD lists the Friday evening event at its Fourth District station.

events.title: Great Country Farms Fall Pumpkin Harvest
events.address: Bluemont, VA 20135; check source for arrival directions
events.description: Walk the corn maze and farm play area during the final pumpkin-harvest days. Pumpkins cost extra; Saturday adds costume parades at 12:30 and 2:30 PM.

events.title: Homelands
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, East Building
events.address: 4th Street and Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: Modern and contemporary artists examine belonging, migration and memory through their connections to place. Find the installation on the East Building mezzanine.

events.title: Hundred Days
events.description: An intimate folk-punk musical about loving fully amid uncertainty. The Bengsons’ story runs approximately 75 minutes without intermission.

events.title: Much Here Is Beautiful: Bicentennial Photography
events.address: 8th and G Streets NW, Washington, DC 20004
events.description: Photographic surveys from around the 1976 Bicentennial reveal varied American communities and landscapes. A thoughtful indoor option with evening museum hours.

events.title: Routed West: African American Quilts in California
events.venue: National Museum of Women in the Arts
events.address: 1250 New York Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20005
events.description: Nearly 80 quilts trace creative traditions carried west during the Second Great Migration. Look for improvisational piecing and works passed between generations.
events.sourceName: National Museum of Women in the Arts
